- zh（默认）：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language. Valid values:

*   zh (default): Chinese
*   en: English
The YAML configuration file of the ServiceMonitor.

description.zh: 试运行。检查格式是否合法、是否能匹配到targets。
description.en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. The system checks whether the format is valid and whether targets are matched.
The ID of the environment instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-env-service-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --aliyun-lang zh --environment-id env-xxxxxx --dry-run true --config-yaml '参见补充说明。' --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms CreateEnvServiceMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --EnvironmentId 'env-xxxxxx' --DryRun true --AliyunLang zh --ConfigYaml '参见补充说明。' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
